name: redline-ai

tools.name: redline_status
tools.description: Show project readiness, latest local evidence, and the next command to run.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

limit.description: Recent reports/history entries to inspect; use 0 for all.

tools.name: redline_doctor
tools.description: Check local redline setup health and print next steps.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

strict.description: Exit non-zero when warnings are present.

tools.name: redline_suite
tools.description: Generate a representative eval suite from baseline prompt-response JSONL logs.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

log_path.description: Baseline JSONL log path. Defaults to configured watched log.

all_cases.description: Include every unique record instead of sampling representative cases.

tools.name: redline_quick_check
tools.description: Generate a temporary suite from baseline JSONL, diff candidate JSONL, and write reports plus a guided local app.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

out_dir.description: Directory for quick-check suite and reports. Defaults to .redline/quick-check.

all_cases.description: Include every unique record instead of sampling representative cases.

open_app.description: Open the guided local app in the default browser.

fail_on.description: Comma-separated statuses that produce exit code 1; use none for report-only.

tools.name: redline_redact
tools.description: Scan or redact common secrets and PII from JSONL prompt-response logs.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

log_path.description: JSONL prompt-response log to scan or redact.

out.description: Redacted JSONL output path. Required unless check is true.

check.description: Scan only; do not write a redacted file.

tools.name: redline_import
tools.description: Normalize exported JSONL fields into redline prompt/response JSONL.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

detect.description: Suggest prompt and response field mappings without writing output.

auto_map.description: Use the best detected prompt/response mapping.

preset.description: Optional import preset such as langfuse, helicone, datadog, dolly, or openai-chat.

input_field.description: Source field path containing prompt text.

output_field.description: Source field path containing response text.

context_field.description: Optional source field path appended to the prompt as Context.

id_field.description: Optional source field path copied to the redline id field.

metadata_fields.description: Source field paths copied into metadata.

preview.description: Preview this many mapped rows without writing output.

no_redact.description: Write raw values without import redaction.

tools.name: redline_watch_stats
tools.description: Summarize observed prompt-response captures, readiness, duplicates, and middleware skip diagnostics.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

log_path.description: Observed prompt-response JSONL log path. Defaults to config.

skip_log.description: Middleware skip diagnostics JSONL to include.

tools.name: redline_watch_snippets
tools.description: Print copy-paste local capture snippets for decorators, SDK patching, or FastAPI middleware.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

kind.description: Capture setup snippet to print. Defaults to all.

tools.name: redline_prompts
tools.description: Scan prompt files, write or check a prompt-to-suite manifest, and verify mapped suites exist.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

path.description: Prompt file or directory to scan.

suite_dir.description: Suite directory to map prompt files into.

out.description: Manifest JSON path to write or check.

check.description: Exit non-zero when the manifest is stale.

check_suites.description: Also exit non-zero when mapped suite files are missing.

tools.name: redline_judges
tools.description: List or copy optional judge templates for semantic review of changed cases.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

copy.description: Template id to copy, or all.

out.description: Output path for one copied template.

tools.name: redline_import_presets
tools.description: List built-in log import presets and their field mappings.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

tools.name: redline_runners
tools.description: List or copy runner adapters for replay commands, log import, and SDK capture.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

copy.description: Runner adapter id to copy, or all.

out.description: Output path for one copied adapter.

tools.name: redline_validate
tools.description: Validate suite or prompt-manifest structure, mapped suites, hashes, requirements, and source freshness.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite or prompt manifest JSON path. Defaults to config.

strict.description: Exit non-zero when warnings are present.

tools.name: redline_summary
tools.description: Summarize suite or prompt-manifest provenance, coverage, behavior groups, owners, requirements, and next steps.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite or prompt manifest JSON path. Defaults to config.

tools.name: redline_benchmark
tools.description: Compatibility alias for redline_budget. Estimate suite or prompt-manifest eval runtime before enabling a gate.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

max_seconds.description: Exit 1 when worst-case eval budget exceeds this.

tools.name: redline_budget
tools.description: Estimate suite or prompt-manifest eval runtime, timeout budget, and CI scale before enabling a gate. Does not replay prompts or call models.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

max_seconds.description: Exit 1 when worst-case eval budget exceeds this.

tools.name: redline_cases
tools.description: List suite cases and IDs so an agent can inspect generated or pinned coverage.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

tools.name: redline_case
tools.description: Show full detail for one suite case, including owner, requirements, source, and baseline response.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

tools.name: redline_mark
tools.description: Mark a case expected, accepted, or ignored after explicit user approval.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

note.description: Required human-readable reason for the judgment.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

out.description: Write updated suite to a new path.

allow_write.description: Must be true because this mutates a local suite file.

tools.name: redline_diff
tools.description: Compare candidate JSONL outputs against a redline suite and return the behavioral diff.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config when omitted.

out_slack.description: Write Slack Block Kit JSON report.

fail_on.description: Comma-separated statuses that produce exit code 1; use none for report-only.

tools.name: redline_eval
tools.description: Replay a suite through a local command and compare candidate outputs to the suite baseline.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

suite_path.description: Suite JSON path. Defaults to config.

prompt.description: Prompt template file to render for each case.

workers.description: Number of replay cases to run concurrently.

out_slack.description: Write Slack Block Kit JSON report.

fail_on.description: Comma-separated statuses that produce exit code 1; use none for report-only.

tools.name: redline_history
tools.description: Append a redline report to local history or show trend history.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

limit.description: Entries to show; use 0 for all.

fail_on.description: Comma-separated trend directions that produce exit code 1; use none for report-only.

tools.name: redline_dashboard
tools.description: Write a self-contained local HTML dashboard for reports and trend history.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

limit.description: Recent reports/history entries to include; use 0 for all.

tools.name: redline_audit
tools.description: Read recent local audit events for evals, redactions, approvals, and requirements.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

path.description: Audit JSONL path. Defaults to config.

limit.description: Recent audit events to show; use 0 for all.

expect_last_hash.description: Expected final audit entry hash for tail checks.

expect_entries.description: Expected audit entry count for tail checks.

out_checkpoint.description: Write a JSON audit checkpoint after verification.

tools.name: redline_sbom
tools.description: Write CycloneDX SBOM release evidence for redline.

cwd.description: Project directory where redline should run.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes returned to the MCP client.

out.description: Write SBOM JSON to this path.

instructions: Use redline tools to generate prompt regression suites, evaluate prompt changes, inspect reports, and review local setup. redline is local-first and does not call cloud models unless a project-configured replay or judge command does.
